name: 반복 패턴 탐지
description: Detects excessive pattern repetition characteristic of AI-generated text.
useCase: Identifying AI text through repetition analysis
mechanism: Analyzes micro-pattern frequency to detect excessive repetition. AI text generators tend to reuse sentence structures and phrases more than human writers.
source: Krishna et al. (2024) - Paraphrasing Evades Detectors of AI-Generated Text
parameters: Window size: adaptive, Quantization: 8-64 levels, Metrics: entropy, CV, correlation
strengths:
- Effective for detecting AI-generated text
- Language-agnostic statistical approach
- Works with any text length
- Low computational overhead
limitations:
- Less effective on edited or paraphrased AI text
- Domain-specific content may trigger false positives
- Short texts provide less reliable signals
- Performance varies across writing styles

references.title: Krishna et al. (2024) - Paraphrasing Evades Detectors of AI-Generated Text
